prompt.name: Artillery (early 1900s steel field howitzer)
prompt.look: An early-1900s steel field howitzer on a two-wheeled carriage: a thick olive-drab steel barrel with a squared breech block and a plain muzzle in a grey steel recoil sleeve, a curved flat steel gun shield in front of the breech, one large spoked steel wheel with a dark tyre and eight spokes, a long steel trail beam sloping back to a flat foot, and a small strapped ammunition box on the trail. A broad painted stripe runs along the gun shield.
prompt.team_area: the broad stripe on the gun shield
prompt.running_gear: One large wheel drawn as a full circle with eight distinct spokes; the trail foot rests on the same ground line and the barrel is horizontal.
prompt.running_gear_check: wheel drawn as a full circle with eight distinct spokes
prompt.identity: the same olive-drab barrel, recoil sleeve, gun shield, spoked wheel, trail, ammunition box and red stripe
prompt.damage_gear: bullet holes in the shield and a bent spoke
prompt.damage_gear_critical: large holes in the shield, bent spokes and a split recoil sleeve

states.note: anchored on the middle of the drawing: the lowest pixels are the trail foot, well left of centre
bounce and wheel spin built in code from the master and from each damage drawing
recoil, muzzle flash and smoke built in code
